intent.goal: Close the #393 rollout window: while pre-#388 wrappers (sidecar lock) and post-#388 wrappers (manifest-inode lock) append to one manifest, they must exclude each other, without ever creating a sidecar (#388).
intent.ruled_out: Creating the sidecar when absent (reintroduces the #388 litter and fingerprint drift); locking the sidecar INSTEAD of the inode (new-vs-new exclusion with no sidecar on disk rests on the inode lock); a rollout note only (coordinator-declined in the spec); lock-free peers (no lock taken here can force a peer to lock — spec scope note); re-checking for a sidecar that appears after the absence check (it would need a drop-and-retake of the inode lock to keep the one order; see noticed_not_touched).
intent.why: The pre-#388 wrapper opens the sidecar with mode 'a' and never removes it (e04b0c2), so every manifest an old wrapper has touched carries one; joining it when present puts old and new writers under the same lock, and taking it before the inode lock keeps a single order among new writers. Opening it 'rb' carries no O_CREAT, so a manifest no old wrapper ever touched stays sidecar-free.
